title: The 'astronaut' photo behind Elizabeth

tellings.quote:
I mean it's like this very famous picture
you know this with Elizabeth this little
girl sitting there with nice dress

plain: There is a very famous photograph of a little girl named Elizabeth in a nice dress, sitting on a moor in England, with what looks like a figure in an astronaut's suit standing behind her. The UFO researcher Clas Svahn mentions it to Michels as a well-known picture, without saying more about where it comes from or when it was taken.
